en.title: Italy vs Austria: 22 % white against 44 %
en.description: Italy vs Austria: 22 % white against 44 %. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Italy on 20 November.
en.lede: 22 % of the mapped high ground is white in Italy, against 44 % in Austria. The deepest resort in Italy has 128 cm; in Austria it is Rifflsee with 120 cm.

p: For a trip near the border this decides the direction: the snow is not where the map of borders would suggest, it is where the last storm went.
The white area in Italy stands at about 20,940 km² today, 3,530 km² less than yesterday. In other words, 22 % of the mapped high ground is white.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Austria: 44 % white, deepest Rifflsee with 120 cm, up to 44 cm in the week ahead; Switzerland: 64 % white, deepest Glacier 3000 with 124 cm, up to 89 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: The resorts with the most snow
p: At the top of the list, Monterosa Ski reports 128 cm.
Close behind: Courmayeur (126 cm), La Thuile ski (120 cm), Valtournenche (112 cm) and Ollomont (82 cm).
At Monterosa Ski: 48 cm of fresh snow over three days, 26 cm more expected by Monday 23 November.
Courmayeur picked up 140 cm in the last three days and could add 80 cm by Monday 23 November.
Count 165 white resorts out of 237 in Italy today.

The rest of the shortlist: La Thuile ski: 120 cm on top, 130 cm in three days, 73 cm expected; Valtournenche: 112 cm on top, 65 cm in three days, 34 cm expected; Ollomont: 82 cm on top, 105 cm in three days, 55 cm expected.
Snow is in the forecast: up to 42 cm by the end of the third day, up to 58 cm within seven days.
The snowiest day looks like Sunday 22 November, with up to 34 cm in the snowiest spots.
The second week adds up to 16 cm where it snows most.
Snow cover in Italy over the last days: 16 November 21,210 km²; 17 November 17,790 km²; 18 November 19,640 km²; 19 November 24,470 km²; 20 November 20,940 km².
The deepest resort changed hands 3 times this week.

Climb and the snow gets deeper: 1,000-1,500 m: on average under 1 cm (6 % of the ground white); 1,500-2,000 m: on average 3 cm (61 % of the ground white); 2,000-2,500 m: on average 10 cm (94 % of the ground white); above 2,500 m: on average 27 cm (99 % white).
A week ago it was 21,760 km²: 820 km² has melted away since. Most of the ground is white from about 1,700 m up.

sections.h: New snow in the last three days
p: In the last 72 hours the most new snow, up to 71 cm, fell over the Aosta Valley, the Piedmont Alps and the central Apennines.
In the past day, up to 26 cm was added.
At least 5 cm fell over some 19,540 km².

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Above 2,000 m the ground is almost fully white (94 % covered), so runs up there have a continuous base.
Between 1,500 m and 2,000 m the cover is patchy, about 61 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
Below 1,500 m the slopes are still almost bare.
If you can choose the day, go after Sunday 22 November: the fresh snow then has time to settle and the roads to be cleared.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: The new snow freshens the upper slopes; lower down it may already be heavy or wet.
Keep an eye on the forecast: the coming snow could change the picture quickly.

advice: Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.
Morning snow is firm after a clear night: wait for the sun on south faces.

it.title: Neve in Italia oggi: altezza del manto nevoso e neve fresca, 20 novembre 2026
it.description: Neve in Italia il 20 novembre: manto nevoso, neve fresca, altezza per quota, prossimi giorni e migliori località.
it.lede: Venerdì 20 novembre: la neve copre circa 20.940 km² delle montagne in Italia. Sono 3.530 km² in meno rispetto a ieri. È il 22 % del territorio montano in Italia che seguiamo.

p: Sette giorni fa la superficie era di 21.760 km², 820 km² in più di adesso. Il terreno è per lo più bianco da circa 1.700 m in su.

Altezza media del manto nevoso per fascia di quota: 1.000–1.500 m: in media meno di 1 cm (6 % innevato); 1.500–2.000 m: in media 3 cm (61 % innevato); 2.000–2.500 m: in media 10 cm (94 % innevato); sopra i 2.500 m: in media 27 cm (99 % innevato).

sections.h: Dove è caduta la neve fresca
p: La neve fresca più abbondante nelle ultime 72 ore: fino a 71 cm. Zone: Valle d'Aosta, Alpi piemontesi e Appennino centrale.
Solo nelle ultime 24 ore sono caduti fino a 26 cm.
Almeno 5 cm di neve fresca coprono circa 19.540 km².
La neve fresca sul fondo regala curve morbide in quota; più in basso resta a chiazze.
Con altra neve in arrivo, i prossimi giorni dovrebbero migliorare.
In testa c'è Monterosa Ski: 128 cm nella parte alta delle piste.
Località con neve sulle piste in quota: 165 su 237.
Seguono: Courmayeur (126 cm), La Thuile ski (120 cm), Valtournenche (112 cm) e Ollomont (82 cm).
Courmayeur: 140 cm di neve fresca in tre giorni e fino a 80 cm in più entro lunedì, 23 novembre.
Previsione di neve fresca: fino a 42 cm in tre giorni e fino a 58 cm in sette giorni.
Il giorno più nevoso: domenica, 22 novembre, fino a 34 cm.
Più avanti, nei giorni 8–14, sui pendii più innevati possono aggiungersi fino a 16 cm.

advice: A inizio stagione la neve sulle rocce è sottile: restate sulle piste battute.
Sopra il limite del bosco la neve può essere ventata: attenzione sulle creste.
